_comment: Shared golden vectors for the canonical-hash implementations (spec/EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md section 6). Mirrors the DgIdMintingService/compute_dg_id golden-vector convention: these literals are duplicated as literal assertions into both the data-service and DG.Tests suites (plans 1200-03/1200-04), not imported from this file at test-run time. Every sha256Upper below is the real, recomputed SHA-256 uppercase hex digest of the accompanying joined/canonical string's UTF-8 bytes -- verified by fixtures/golden/../1200-02-PLAN.md Task 1's automated check, which recomputes and compares rather than trusting the literal.

vectors.description: The existing shipped dgId golden vector (STATE.md / DgIdMintingService / compute_dg_id parity anchor) -- reproduced here so cross-checking the shared scalar-tuple hashing convention against fixtures/golden's own object dgIds is possible without re-deriving it.
dgId minting input for fixtures/golden/fixture.json's OBJ_GOLD_PASS object (project|definitionId|cgId), truncated-to-16-hex form is fixture.json's OBJ_GOLD_PASS.dgId = dg:57C65BE15E8E368B.
dgId minting input for fixtures/golden/fixture.json's OBJ_GOLD_FAIL object; truncated-to-16-hex form is fixture.json's OBJ_GOLD_FAIL.dgId = dg:729E143958721742.

Nested-payload canonicalization exercising key ordering (out-of-order input keys sorted ascending by Unicode code point), integer formatting (count:3, no decimal point), fixed-point decimal formatting (height:82.5, not 82.50 or 82.5000...), and a non-ASCII character that must NOT be escaped (the c-cedilla in Facade and e-acute in Cafe, already in precomposed NFC form).

Nested-payload canonicalization exercising Unicode NFC normalization: 'note' is authored in decomposed NFD form (e + combining acute accent) and must be normalized to precomposed NFC before hashing, per rule 4. Also exercises a zero integer, a fixed-point decimal (0.1, not 0.10 or 1e-1), and key ordering.
vectors._authoring_note: The 'note' value as authored for this vector is the NFD-decomposed form of 'Cafe' + combining U+0301; the canonical field below is computed AFTER NFC normalization per rule 4, so it renders as the precomposed U+00E9 form.

vectors.description: CR-01 regression vector: a decimal whose stored scale carries trailing zeros must render identically on both legs -- height:100.00 (an integral value at scale 2, the case the old C# integral fast-path silently rounded to 100) and ratio:2.50 (a non-integral value at scale 2, the case the old C# 0.# format silently trimmed to 2.5). Also exercises a plain integer (bindingCount:3, still no decimal point) and a string (ruleId), plus key ordering.
